sar.narrative: On or about 2016-12-29 07:53:54, financial institution detection systems identified suspicious activity associated with account holder C08106 on card C08106-K1. Transaction 3583227 in the amount of $128.33 was executed via the online channel (C). The transaction exhibited significant anomalies including 4.6x deviation from historical median spending and novel device profile infrastructure (firefox 47.0). Contact was initiated with the cardholder, who confirmed that the transaction was unauthorized and executed without their consent. The identified activity represents confirmed card not present new device with total unauthorized exposure of $128.33. In accordance with federal Bank Secrecy Act and Suspicious Activity Reporting guidelines, the compromised card has been placed under permanent block and scheduled for reissue, and all connected network entities are subject to ongoing monitoring.
